BrochureContent.Content:
A fabulous opportunity to acquire a turnkey, perfectly presented-to-the-market, fine 4-bedroom, 1-bathroom (master-en-suite) detached bungalow, originally constructed in 1999. This impressive property sits on just under half an acre of land, making it an excellent development opportunity for a larger property with ample private car parking and gardens if required. It has oil-fired central heating, mains water, and a private septic tank.

The property is extremely private to the rear and is not overlooked by any other house. Looking out over protected wetland, you can see the ocean to your right-hand side, with the beach and ocean to your left-hand side, and more wetland. The property is in very good condition internally and externally. It has double-glazed PVC windows and doors. The property has front and rear gardens, ample private car parking, and a very good, spacious modern garage (excellant for storage)

This detached home is located in a stunning setting within less than 100 meters walking distance of Garrylucas Blue Flag Beach, a well-known beach for swimmers and surfers alike. Located just along the Wild Atlantic Way, a mere 2.5 km from Ballinspittle village and 11 km from Kinsale town centre.

This house has a floor area of 990.28 sq. ft. (92 Sq. m.) with accommodation consisting of separate sitting with an open fireplace, a fully fitted kitchen dining cum area, 4 fine bedrooms, 1 main family bathroom.

For those who don't: Garrettstown and Garrylucas beaches, the Wild Atlantic Ocean, and the Old Head of Kinsale are quite simply stunning and beautiful natural areas. The property lends itself perfectly to use as a family home or holiday home and has scope to be enlarged to take further advantage of its setting and spacious site. For those seeking a perfect coastal lifestyle property within close proximity to the beautiful village of Ballinspittle and the iconic town of Kinsale, at the start of the Wild Atlantic Way, this property offers a most beautiful and wonderful lifestyle location.

LOCATION
Kinsale is one of Ireland's most picturesque, popular, and fashionable towns. It is situated only 17 miles from Cork City, making it ideal for commuters. The pretty seaside town of Kinsale is a mere 25-minute drive from the cosmopolitan city of Cork. This area of South West Ireland is of outstanding beauty with its dramatic coastline, unspoilt locations, and safe beaches. Leisure activities are well catered for; Kinsale provides excellent sailing, yachting and fishing facilities from its two marinas. There are three world-class golf courses, including the renowned Old Head of Kinsale. Other recreational pursuits include walking, bathing, surfing, and horse riding. There are numerous cultural events held throughout the year, including the world-famous Kinsale Arts Festival, the Cork Jazz Festival, the Cork Film Festival, and the Kinsale Gourmet Festival, as well as a thriving music and opera programme. Cork has several fine theatres, and the Cork Opera House hosts many exceptional productions yearly. Kinsale is also home to some of Ireland's finest restaurants, contributing to its title as Gourmet Capital of Ireland. It also has many top-class hotels and lots of welcoming pubs. Cork International Airport is conveniently located 20 minutes' drive from Kinsale, with direct links within Ireland and to Major European and UK cities.
